title: Semantic architecture and inhabited street edges
description: Procedural OSM-tag-based facades: shops/cafes, homes/apartments, civic/school/church, medical and workshop entrances. Named signage, porches, balconies, shop windows, seating, planters and loading areas. Street-facing placement uses nearest actual road segment. Batches facade geometry. Fictional designs, no imagery or building interiors.
author: the internet slop warehouse
